messages:
maria_sales: FYI BigCorp procurement just flagged that their PO needs to be dated before month-end for the committed discount to apply. Marketplace listing shows the SKU as `redwood.marketplace.v1` but their finance system pulls `redwood.marketplace.monthly`. Billing mismatch might break the commit detection.
jack_dealdesk: ack. Do we have a SKU mapping table? If mapping isn't exact the marketplace metering may not attribute the usage to the commit.
alex_se: We ran into this in a POC last quarter — platform treats marketplace SKUs by offer-id + sku code. If the customer's PO references their internal SKU name, the downstream SFTP invoice will not match.
sophie_finance: @maria_sales can you confirm the PO will reference our marketplace SKU or the customer's internal one? If it's the latter we need the PO to include the marketplace offer id for reconciliation.
maria_sales: They sent a draft PO sample. It references "Redwood LLM - monthly" (their internal label). They can’t change their internal template quickly. Procurement wants to sign now but says their system only accepts end-of-month cutoffs for new vendor pricing.
jack_dealdesk: Two options: 1) get a retroactive invoice/credit if we accept the PO as-is and apply the commit manually, or 2) create a Private Offer (AWS/Azure) that maps to their vendor flow and has the commit attached so marketplace attribution is explicit. Both need approvals.
alex_se: Private Offer route is cleaner but takes ~3–5 business days to provision and the customer wants to start the POC this week. If we do retro invoice + credit we must document and get legal sign-off for special term.
sophie_finance: Finance prefers Private Offer (clean audit trail). If timeline forced, we can do a one-time manual reconciliation but need deal desk + finance + accounting on record. @jack_dealdesk can you draft the approval email?
jack_dealdesk: drafting now. Proposed fallback text: "Redwood will accept PO referencing customer label and will manually attribute billing to the committed SKU for the month of March 2026. A credit will be issued if marketplace metering fails to recognize the referenced SKU. This is a one-time exception subject to deal desk approval."
maria_sales: Customer response: they can sign immediately if we accept the PO as-is and guarantee the discount. They prefer not to wait for Private Offer.
deploy-bot: reminder: marketplace private-offer creation requires product->partner config + legal PO flow; ETA 48-72h once deal desk approves.
jack_dealdesk: OK — I'll circulate to legal and finance for sign-off now. Action items: 1) @jack_dealdesk send approval draft (in progress), 2) @sophie_finance confirm credit process and GL codes, 3) @alex_se prepare SKU mapping snippet for accounting, 4) @maria_sales hold customer sign until we confirm a) legal ok or b) Private Offer created.
alex_se: SKU mapping snippet (for accounting):
```
{
  "marketplace_offer_id": "offer_az_01",
  "marketplace_sku": "redwood.marketplace.v1",
  "customer_sku_label": "Redwood LLM - monthly",
  "billing_entity": "redwood-azure-prod",
  "notes": "map customer label to marketplace_sku for March 2026 commit"
}
```
sophie_finance: GL codes = SALES_RECUR_01 for revenue, CREDIT_RETRO_01 for any manual credit. I'll queue a memo to accounting.
jack_dealdesk: sending to legal now. If legal approves the one-time exception language we can accept PO today and I will log the manual attribution in the deal notes. If legal rejects, we escalate to Private Offer flow.
maria_sales: I'll tell the buyer we're targeting same-day acceptance pending legal nod. Please ping here with verdict. :crossed_fingers:
jack_dealdesk: legal replied — need to add a 45-day maximum for manual credits (audit window) and require a signed acknowledgment from the customer. I've updated the draft and re-sent.
sophie_finance: finance ok with the 45-day limit. Accounting also requests a copy of the signed acknowledgment before issuing credit.
maria_sales: customer confirmed they can sign an ack. Good to go. I'll attach their signed doc once received.
jack_dealdesk: final: deal desk approves one-time exception with the updated language. Recording: approved by jack_dealdesk, sophie_finance, legal. Proceed to accept PO and manually attribute billing.
maria_sales: accepted — sharing PO and signed ack now. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
